thread:
Maya (Sales): passing TremoSys to CS — midmarket, 6-month pilot (3 seats). They want SSO (Okta), private eval in our eu-west region, and a data residency note. Renewal in ~10 months. @Jorge can you take point? Contract + legal notes: https://redwood.at/terms/TremoSys-PSA
Jorge (CS): on it. quick Qs: who is the technical contact at TremoSys? and do they require dedicated capacity or is private VPC enough for pilot?
Maya (Sales): tech contact is "Anil Rao" (anil@tremosys.com). Pilot expected to be dev/test traffic — VPC private deploy should be fine for now. Sales flagged potential need for Dedicated if latency/throughput spikes. Also note: they want logs in their Splunk instance.
Liam (SE): FYI on the infra side — for private eval in eu-west we need: VPC peering, customer subnet list, and their cert for mTLS. Also Splunk forwarder requires outbound firewall rule to splunk-collector.tremosys.com:8088
Priya (Support Eng): can we confirm which log format they need? json_lines or syslog? Splunk HTTP Event Collector prefers json. Also need contact for onboarding windows (timezone CET).
Harper (Onboarding PM): I'll own scheduling. Jorge — do you want a 30-min tech kickoff + a 1-hr enablement session for their product team? Propose next Tue/Wed morning CET. I can send calendar invites once we confirm owners.
Jorge (CS): yes to both. I'll run the tech kickoff with Priya and Liam on the call. Action list for initial pass:
1) Collect VPC CIDRs + cert (owner: Anil / TremoSys)
2) Confirm Splunk HEC token + format (owner: Anil)
3) Confirm SSO connector details (Okta org + service account) (owner: Maya)
4) Provision private eval in eu-west (owner: Liam)
5) Schedule tech kickoff + enablement (owner: Harper)
Maya (Sales): adding context — customer cares about audit logs and role-based access. Also asked about a possible HIPAA data flow later (longer term). Keep privacy/compliance flag on the case.
Priya (Support Eng): noted. For audit logs we can set up S3 export + Splunk ingestion. Will draft minimal runbook for S3->Splunk mapping and share.
Liam (SE): provisioning notes (copying here):
```terraform
resource "redwood_private_instance" "tremosys_eval" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
  instance_size = "m10g"
  vpc_peer = "vpce-012345"
}
```
I'll create infra ticket once we have CIDRs and cert.
deploy-bot: new infra ticket created: INF-8842 (provision private eval - eu-west) — assigned to Liam
Jorge (CS): excellent. next steps: Maya to confirm SSO org + Anil contact; Anil to supply CIDRs, cert, and Splunk token; Liam to update INF-8842 when ready; Harper to propose two times for kickoff. I will follow up with a short summary email to Anil after this thread.
Maya (Sales): I pinged Anil already. He said he'll send CIDRs + cert by EOD tomorrow. putting a :thumbsup:
Harper (Onboarding PM): I'll ping again here when invites are sent. Tentative owners assigned in the thread — Jorge (CS) lead, Harper scheduling, Liam infra, Priya support runbook.
Jorge (CS): tagging final reminders: add renewal owner to the account (Maya) and mark renewal window in Gainsight. Also create a feedback capture doc for pilot (owner: Jorge) — short NPS + 5 targeted workflow checks.
Priya (Support Eng): I'll add a troubleshooting checklist to the doc (token rotation, cert chain errors, common firewall failures). Will drop link to doc once ready.
Jorge (CS): thanks everyone — I'll post the brief summary and owners into the CRM and close the loop once the kickoff is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
